scenarios.title: Blood Moor to Cold Plains: the hero walks the exit and arrives (exit refusal baseline, knobs OFF then ON via D2SCEN_KNOBS)
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 8, purse 1500, field start in the Blood Moor by debug goto 2 (CHEATED position). Mechanics only.
scenarios.notes: Run twice per class and seed: defaults, then D2SCEN_KNOBS=nav.warpRead=1,nav.fullGrid=1. The evidence is the count of 'unwanted exit' and 'mouth gate' lines in the bot log next to the verdict (run 6208 and c261 never produced a refusal in the Blood Raven scenario; the refusal of the fresh drill happened on this walk). U: the farm goal walks to Cold Plains first.

assert.why: the hero crossed into Cold Plains (or went on from it / back to town)

scenarios.title: Standing in the Barracks: walk back up to the Outer Cloister (the return leg of the Monastery road)
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 26, gold 3000, potions, field start in the Barracks (area 28) by debug goto 28, then debug warp 38 64 (subtiles 190,320, the walked-in arrival point of the live capture 2026-11-23: 25 subtiles above the south strip). CHEATED position. Mechanics only.
scenarios.notes: The return leg of the stage 1 failure (run 20261123-023115-028d: from the Barracks `nav no usable gate from 28 to 27`, `border not readable from here, walking to its strip`). Goal: leave the Barracks for the Outer Cloister. The forward leg is the toolstrade work (act1.tools.*). The plain goto start (65,212) stood far from the arrival strip and the planner found no plan (run 20261123-033306); the warp is the second start for the same level (Scenario.Warp). U: the warp cell lands on the walked-in point, the cell size of 5 subtiles is S (the scenario schema comment); the first lab run decides. Pass: 'Entered Outer Cloister' and no 'unwanted exit' refusal line in the bot log (count it next to the verdict as in nav.bloodmoor-coldplains).

assert.why: the hero walked back up out of the Barracks
the return leg is not refused by the unwanted-exit mouth gate

scenarios.title: Standing in the Inner Cloister: walk north to the Cathedral (the Cathedral is a border link d2d links only near its edge)
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 24, field start in the Inner Cloister (area 32) by debug goto 32 (CHEATED position). Mechanics only.
scenarios.notes: V live 2026-11-24 (Andariel try-anyway, deploy 62): Inner Cloister to Cathedral, `nav no usable gate from 32 to 33`, exits 1 (the warp to Jail 3 only), adjacent 0, pending 1, three times. The lab warps list of level 32 has one warp too (tools/probes/warptrig.py, devp27); the Cathedral is 34 tiles north and linked only near the edge (strips.py: side N, verdict open). Fix: an unlinked neighbour keeps its strip as unproven (internal/d2dworld/border.go). Live attempt 3 (2026-11-24 13:31 EST, deploy 63) failed here although seed 11 passed: the same strip (51,2) was pushed five times without crossing. The fix rotates along the border, scans a frontier of 12 rows and logs the scan (nav: crossing an unproven border strip ... scan=).

assert.why: the hero walked north out of the Inner Cloister into the Cathedral

scenarios.title: Standing in area 33: take the stairs down to Catacombs Level 1 (a hop of the Andariel route)
